body: My heart quickens as the low hum grows louder, and I strain my ears to pinpoint the source. The air seems to vibrate with an otherworldly energy. I feel a thrill of curiosity, urging me to investigate further. I carefully make my way to the floorboards, my footsteps silent on the wooden planks. As I approach, the hum grows more intense, and I can feel an unseen force pulling me closer.
